name: Solar & Lunar Phase Tracker
author: makehasteslowly
description: Real-time Solar & Lunar phase tracker for the Omarchy bar featuring offline NOAA/Meeus astronomical calculations, automatic weather, IP & system-timezone location sync with manual coordinate override, custom vector moon terminator rendering, a 24-hour sky horizon arc, blue hour & golden hour timetable, lunar quarter/full/new countdowns, and a 7-day lunar phase forecast.

barWidget.description: Combined solar cycle & lunar phase indicator with 24h sky horizon arc, blue & golden hour times, and 7-day moon forecast.

schema.label: Bar Display Mode
schema.description: Choose what appears on the bar: Both Solar & Lunar (icon + illumination%), Compact Icons, Detailed (next solar event + moon %), Dynamic (Sun by day / Moon by night), Lunar only, or Solar only. Right-click the widget to switch anytime.

options.label: 󰖨  Dynamic (Sun by day, Moon by night)

schema.label: Celestial Colors
schema.description: Choose between Soft Celestial colors, Bold Vivid celestial colors, or the active Omarchy theme's colors.

options.label: Soft Celestial (Warm solar gold & lunar silver-blue)
Bold Vivid (High-saturation amber sun & electric cyan moon)

schema.label: Moon Phase Renderer
schema.description: Render the moon phase as a smooth custom vector disc with exact terminator geometry, or as a Nerd Font glyph.

schema.label: Time Format
schema.description: Format sunrise, sunset, golden hour, and solar noon times in 12-hour, 24-hour, or system locale format.

schema.label: Manual Latitude Override
schema.description: Optional decimal latitude (-90 to 90, e.g. 38.72). Leave empty to automatically sync with Omarchy Weather or IP geolocation.

schema.label: Manual Longitude Override
schema.description: Optional decimal longitude (-180 to 180, e.g. -9.14). Leave empty to automatically sync with Omarchy Weather or IP geolocation.

schema.label: Custom Location Label
schema.description: Optional city/place name displayed when using manual coordinates.
